title: nuphar advena subsp. ozarkana
intro: Nuphar advena subsp. ozarkana, commonly known as the Ozark water lily or yellow water lily, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Nymphaeaceae. This aquatic plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Nuphar advena subsp. ozarkana include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
